title: DataBall must declare its relay profile for scripted landing
lead: The agents-repo `relay-land.sh` (agents queue S59) reads each project's check commands and code paths from a `.relay-profile` file at the project root. Add DataBall's profile, and point `AGENTS.md`'s slice-relay section at it, so landing a DataBall slice is one scripted command instead of the hand sequence used for db-07 to db-09.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** the scripts themselves (agents S57 to S59); slicer's `verify --landed` (slicer queue s245); changing which checks DataBall runs.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The owner decided on 2026-10-10 that deterministic relay chores become scripts. DataBall's check commands live only in the prose of `AGENTS.md` ("Build, test, format"). The land script needs them in a form it can read. The rule "rerun the check only when main gained code" also needs DataBall's code paths.

The format is defined by agents-repo S59: `key=value` lines and `#` comments, with keys `check` (repeatable), `code_paths`, `main` and `worktrees`.

This item waits on agents S59. slicer cannot express a dependency across repositories, so do not start it before S59 lands there.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `.relay-profile` (new):
  - `check=dotnet build DataBall.sln -c Release`
  - `check=dotnet test DataBall.sln -c Release`
  - `check=dotnet format DataBall.sln --verify-no-changes`
  - `code_paths=src tests DataBall.sln Directory.Build.props global.json`
  - `main=main`
  - `worktrees=.worktrees`
- `AGENTS.md`, "Slice relay": say that landing reads `.relay-profile`, and that the build, test and format commands are listed there as well as under "Build, test, format". Keep the two lists identical.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: No product tests. Validation is the agents-repo profile parser (S59) accepting the file.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Confirm S59 has landed in the agents repo and that its profile format matches this spec. Adjust if the format changed.
2. Add `.relay-profile` and the `AGENTS.md` line.
3. Validate the file with S59's parser. Do a dry run of the land script against a throwaway branch in a scratch clone.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The S59 profile parser accepts `.relay-profile` with no errors.
- Every `check=` line in `.relay-profile` matches the commands in `AGENTS.md`.
- `slicer check`.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One DataBall commit on a feature branch, merged after the owner's go-ahead.

sections.heading: Interacts with
sections.body:
- `AGENTS.md`'s "Build, test, format" and "Slice relay" sections.
- The landing rule from 2026-10-10: rerun the full check after a merge only when main gained code.
- CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs restore, build and test but not format. The profile is for local landing only and does not change CI.

sections.heading: Must not change
sections.body:
- CI and the release workflow.
- The commands in `AGENTS.md`. They stay the source a person reads, and the profile mirrors them.
